Settings.IgnoreAttack.Desc: When scaling is 0, the target does not show hostility.
Configs.Explanation.Title: Explanation
Configs.Explanation.Content1: 1. Rule: Damage = Attacker|Victim|Scaling. Damage scaling ranges from 0.0 to 10000.0.
Configs.Explanation.Content2: 2. Within one file, only the last matching rule applies. Across different files, the applicable multipliers are multiplied together.
Configs.Explanation.Content3: 3. Open the console and select the actor. The conditions that match this actor will be highlighted.
